form_inputs.box_type: Public Contract / Validation Evidence Merge Guard
form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
Validation evidence merge must accept equivalent feature IDs when one uses underscores and the saved KANDA_FREEZE_HINT identity uses hyphenated safe slugs.
Validation evidence merge must still reject truly unrelated feature IDs.
Freeze hint intake state must remain under the selected active project root at project_freeze_after_update/freeze_hint_intake.
KANDA_FREEZE_HINT.json must remain patch ZIP root delivery metadata and must not be installed into the active project root.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
form_inputs.feature_title: Freeze Hint Feature ID Alias Merge v1
form_inputs.known_warnings: This is a focused repair for the freeze_hint_intake merge guard exposed by local validation. It does not change GUI behavior, parser behavior, or freeze writer behavior.
form_inputs.notes: The previous validation failed because saved freeze hints normalize feature_id values with safe hyphen slugs while validation evidence commonly uses underscore IDs. This patch treats those aliases as the same feature identity while preserving mismatch protection for unrelated feature IDs.
form_inputs.planned_next_step: Install locally, run validation, confirm VALIDATION OK: freeze_hint_feature_id_alias_merge_v1, then rerun the previous freeze_tab_freeze_hint_intake_restore_v1 validation if desired.
form_inputs.validation_evidence_summary:
SANDBOX VALIDATION OK: freeze_hint_feature_id_alias_merge_v1
LOCAL VALIDATION PENDING: run the provided validation block before freezing
